title: The 1995-96 official statement that the remote viewing program never produced useful intelligence

tellings.quote: I think 96 was like this dine thing where they came out and said like, "Oh, it's uh it's not re like it's real, but like we had this program

plain: In the United States there was a government program on remote viewing, the claimed ability to describe faraway places or hidden things using only the mind. Chris Ramsay, a researcher speaking on podcast host Jesse Michels's show, recalls that around 1995 or 1996 officials came out with a statement about it, which he remembers loosely as saying that yes, they had such a program, but that it never gave them useful intelligence. He tells it because the official statement is how the program was publicly closed out.
